cases.obstruction: No provided mapping from unordered firing rank-k hyperedges or stateful multi-event conflicts to Hilbert clock/momentum constraints; quantum probability, dimensionality and mass remain external inputs.

versionAndInterpretationNotes: Source extraction is equation- and section-level; it is not a faithful computational reproduction of either paper.
These two papers are selected examples showing how bibliography-only rows differ from structural test-ready records.
The corpus has 197 records and 0 complete source-by-source theorem/transition-level mappings. This pilot does not by itself satisfy readiness gate C2.
The Favalli introduction itself expressly distinguishes embedding existing wave equations from first-principles derivations; preserve that negative qualification.
Arenas original equations make explicit that continuum time, spatial embedding, fields and adjacency are inputs, not native unbounded causal emergence.
